title: Draganfly Signs Exclusive Agreement to Provide Drone Manufacturing in the Philippines
body_markdown:
*Canadian drone technology and engineering expertise to build, expand and support Philippine capabilities in drones and autonomous systems across public safety, infrastructure and critical industrial sectors.*


**Manila, Philippines, Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —** Draganfly Inc. (NASDAQ: DPRO; CSE: DPRO; FSE: 3U8) (“Draganfly” or the “Company”), a Canadian drone manufacturer, today announced that it has signed an exclusive agreement with Prime Strategic Holdings, Inc., a Philippine holding company part of **the Razon Group of Companies.** The initiative will combine Canadian-developed drone technology and engineering expertise with Philippine industrial capabilities to support disaster response as well as local manufacturing, agriculture, training and sustainment of unmanned systems across port and mining operations, and critical infrastructure protection.


The exclusive agreement sets out a framework for a joint venture to establish a manufacturing and technology capability in the Philippines, with Canadian design and engineering supporting systems tailored to local operating requirements.


The partnership is designed to strengthen the Philippines’ ability to respond to disasters, manufacture, maintain and support unmanned systems domestically, reducing reliance on externally sourced, fully assembled platforms and supporting greater operational self-sufficiency.


“The next phase of unmanned systems is not just about delivering drone platforms. It’s about the ability to build, adapt and support them where they are needed,” said Cameron Chell, Chief Executive Officer of Draganfly. Prime Strategic brings not just the local industrial experience, but also the immediate requirement to deploy drone technologies across its enterprises in the Philippines and beyond. Draganfly brings more than 27 years of drone technology, innovation, engineering and services. Together, we have an opportunity to develop the preeminent capabilities that can scale with the surging requirements of the Philippines and the region. I also want to acknowledge Prime Minister Carney for his leadership and encouragement in building relationships and opening opportunities to bring Canadian technology and expertise to new international markets.”


Draganfly also acknowledges Global Affairs Canada (GAC), Export Development Canada (EDC), the Canadian Commercial Corporation (CCC) and the Canada-ASEAN Business Council (CABC) for their instrumental support and collaboration in advancing this initiative.


The initiative will draw upon Draganfly’s established capabilities in unmanned aerial systems, platform development, systems integration and mission-specific technologies. Canadian design and engineering teams are expected to underpin the base systems, with Canadian executives and specialists providing leadership, training, engineering and production support, and direct engagement with operational end users.


The approach is aligned with areas of growing cooperation between Canada and the Philippines, including industrial development, smart port operations, mining, agriculture and disaster response. Potential applications include port operations, critical infrastructure monitoring, disaster management, and other missions requiring reliable unmanned systems and local sustainment.


The initiative is designed to expand the Company’s manufacturing and service capacity and deepen its presence in the Philippine market. Additional production volume, if realized, could also support efficiencies across Draganfly’s broader operations.


“We’re building a Canadian technology company that can serve customers well beyond our home market,” added Chell. “Partnerships like this give us a way to apply our engineering in new markets, build production scale and continue strengthening the capabilities we develop in Canada.”


The Philippines represents a strategically important market for Draganfly, with opportunities to apply its drone technology and engineering expertise across maritime and port operations, critical infrastructure monitoring, public safety and disaster response. Developing local manufacturing and technical capabilities would position the Company to support these needs while building a foundation for broader growth across Southeast Asia.


The exclusive agreement establishes a framework for advancing the contemplated joint venture and related manufacturing initiatives. Draganfly Innovations Inc. and the relevant Razon Group signing entity will continue working toward definitive agreements addressing governance, ownership, technology licensing, manufacturing operations, commercialization and other necessary arrangements.


**About Draganfly**


Draganfly Inc. (NASDAQ: DPRO; CSE: DPRO; FSE: 3U8), the parent company of Draganfly Innovations Inc., is a Canadian-headquartered developer of advanced drone solutions, unmanned systems and software serving customers across North America and globally. With more than 27 years of experience in unmanned systems, Draganfly develops and delivers technologies spanning aerial platforms, autonomy, sensing, payload integration and mission-specific solutions for public safety and commercial applications.


The Company combines engineering, manufacturing, software and systems-integration capabilities to support customers operating in complex and mission-critical environments. Draganfly is driven by a mission to provide innovative, reliable solutions that save time, money and lives.


For more information, visit[www.draganfly.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=uccRRbaoNt4jX6Iqxo0qhufJN1y31-0sClQ_389hjdRRDeH6gMQrtVTSGAHZGfcsmsvqHxUhDBOcnTB2n66wH6178TrbbQTXfpNbZ9Zy5Po=) .


**About Prime Strategic Holdings, Inc.**


Prime Strategic Holdings, Inc. (PSHI) is a diversified Philippine investment company. Either directly or through its affiliated companies, PSHI has Philippine and overseas investments infrastructure, energy including sustainable fuels, mining, water sourcing and distribution, power distribution, hospitality, and real estate.
